statement: ∀ (b : ℂ), b ≠ 0 → ∃ e : R p ≃ₗ[R p] (Submodule.span (R p) ({b} : Set ℂ)), ∀ r : R p, (e r : ℂ) = r • b
proof:
intro b hb
let e := LinearEquiv.toSpanNonzeroSingleton (R p) ℂ b hb
exact ⟨e, fun r => rfl⟩
